items.title: File Einspruch against the Kfz-Steuerbescheid
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 27.12.2024, sent by ordinary post by a tax authority. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as stated on the letter itself: 'am dritten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post') it counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting = Mon 30.12.2024. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruchsfrist starts the next day (30.12.2024 is itself the delivery day, counting from it) and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, i.e. Thu 30.01.2025. That day is a normal business day in NW (no shift needed under § 108 Abs. 3 AO).

items.computation: The letter states only that the yearly amount is collected in advance by SEPA direct debit; it gives no specific collection date, so an exact due date cannot be determined from this letter.

warnings: The letter gives no exact date for the direct-debit collection of the €186.00 annual tax, only that it happens 'jährlich im Voraus' (yearly, in advance); check your bank statements or contact the Hauptzollamt if you need the exact debit date.
The IBAN printed (DE03 2900 0000 0029 0010 20) is a valid German IBAN, consistent with a Bundeskasse/Zoll account for the direct debit; no unusual foreign account was found.
